records.source: Despite its high toxicity, this Mineral is widely used in manufacturing and folk medicine.
records.translation: Sa kabila ng pagiging lubhang nakalalason nito, malawak na ginagamit ang mineral na ito sa paggawa at katutubong panggagamot.

records.source: It may be the world's largest egg.
records.translation: Maaaring ito ang pinakamalaking itlog sa mundo.

records.source: Constantly filters water to find food. In the process, it removes dangerous toxins from the environment.
records.translation: Patuloy nitong sinasala ang tubig upang makahanap ng pagkain. Sa prosesong iyon, inaalis nito ang mapanganib na lason sa kapaligiran.

records.englishResidueReason: Ale is the conventional brewing loanword used for this beer style.

records.source: A delicate broth with a hint of sulfur.
records.translation: Pinong sabaw na may bahagyang lasa ng asupre.

records.source: Palm Fossils are relatively common, but this happens to be a particularly well-preserved specimen.
records.translation: Medyo karaniwan ang mga Posil ng Palma, ngunit pambihira ang husay ng pagkapanatili ng ispesimeng ito.

records.englishResidueReason: Pancake is the familiar borrowed Filipino food name used consistently in existing recipe text.

records.source: A double stack of fluffy, soft pancakes.
records.translation: Dalawang salansan ng maalsa at malalambot na pancake.
records.englishResidueReason: Pancake is the familiar borrowed Filipino food name used consistently in existing recipe text.

records.preserveReason: Parsnip is the established Filipino loan name already used consistently for this crop in the runtime UI.

records.source: A spring tuber closely related to the carrot. It has an earthy taste and is full of nutrients.
records.translation: Ugat na pananim sa tagsibol na malapit na kamag-anak ng karot. Malinamnam ang lasa nito at hitik sa sustansiya.

records.englishResidueReason: Parsnip is the established Filipino loan name already used consistently for this crop in the runtime UI.

records.source: Plant these in the spring. Takes 4 days to mature.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa tagsibol. Tumatagal ng 4 na araw upang mahinog.

records.englishResidueReason: Parsnip is the established Filipino loan name already used consistently for this crop in the runtime UI.

records.source: It's almost fuzzy to the touch.
Takes 28 days to produce a mature Peach tree. Bears fruit in the summer. Only grows if the 8 surrounding "tiles" are empty.
records.translation: Tumatagal ng 28 araw upang maging ganap na puno ng Melokoton. Namumunga sa tag-init. Lumalaki lamang kung walang laman ang 8 nakapaligid na "parisukat".

records.source: A rare treasure from the sea.
Spicy breaded peppers filled with cheese.
records.translation: Maanghang na mga siling binalutan ng mumo ng tinapay at pinalamanan ng keso.

records.source: Plant these in the summer. Takes 5 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa tag-init. Tumatagal ng 5 araw upang mahinog at patuloy na namumunga matapos ang unang ani.

records.preserveReason: Perch is the conventional borrowed Filipino name for this fish species.

records.source: A freshwater fish of the winter.
records.translation: Isdang tubig-tabang na matatagpuan sa taglamig.

records.preserveReason: Periwinkle is the conventional borrowed name for this specific freshwater snail.

records.source: A tiny freshwater snail that lives in a blue shell.
records.translation: Munting kuhol sa tubig-tabang na naninirahan sa bughaw na kabibi.

records.source: Invite a new pet into your home. If you don't have enough outdoor pet bowls for your pets, they will become upset.
records.translation: Mag-anyaya ng bagong alagang hayop sa iyong tahanan. Kapag kulang ang mangkok sa labas para sa iyong mga alaga, sasama ang loob nila.

records.englishResidueReason: Slime is the canonical Filipino glossary's retained creature name.

records.source: This little guy may be 100,000 years old.
records.translation: Maaaring 100,000 taon na ang munting nilalang na ito.

records.englishResidueReason: Phoenix is the conventional borrowed Filipino name for the mythological bird.

records.source: Once a day, regain some health after being knocked out in combat.
records.translation: Minsan bawat araw, mababawi mo ang kaunting kalusugan matapos mawalan ng malay sa labanan.
